# FireSafe

> FireSafe manufactures advanced calcium silicate boards and fire protection systems for industrial and construction applications with 13+ years of expertise.

FireSafe specializes in passive fire protection products including calcium silicate boards (FireSafe-500, FireSafe-750, FireSafe-900 series), fire-rated ductwork solutions, fire sealants, coatings, and partition systems. The company maintains ISO 9001 certification and serves global markets with products meeting ASTM standards for fire resistance, thermal insulation, and structural performance.
